cap_ClWeek.text:
Capabilities: week-grid, work-package-bars, meeting-work-package-chip, show-switches, project-filter, drag-to-change-dates.
What you see: The week of 12 to 18 October. Work package bars sit in the all-day strip in their type colour, BUG #58231 shows the grab handles, and the meetings below carry their work package chip.

cap_ClEvent.text:
Capabilities: event-panel, mail-origin, accept-maybe-decline, linked-work-package, log-time.
What you see: The Thursday rollout review selected. The panel shows the attendees, the mail the invitation came from, FEATURE #58412 and Log time on this work package with 1 h filled in.

cap_ClMonth.text:
Capabilities: month-grid, work-package-bars, milestone, new-from-empty-day.
What you see: October 2026 into November. EPIC #57990 and FEATURE #58412 span their weeks, the Go-live Lyon milestone is a diamond on 2 November, and an empty day offers New meeting and New work package.
